title: Design-Based Minimax Variance and Testing Power under Network Interference with Bernoulli Assignment
banked_reason: D0.5.G: delivered tier incremental below field floor; the advertised matched all-test frontier lacks checkable shifted-support and QE certificates.
gap_reasons: The load-bearing uniform bound (5) is asserted after an unspecified rational-function cancellation: neither the numerator nor a checkable certificate is supplied, so the claimed all-t shifted-support L2 second-derivative bound (and hence the explicit Hellinger constant) cannot be reproduced from the declared dependencies.

The K3 and C4 upper bounds rest entirely on asserted QE implications (4) and (7), but the projection polynomials, isolating/sign data, or an independently checkable certificate are absent; the displayed witnesses establish only lower bounds, not v_K3 and v_C4.

What is securely delivered is unbiased quadratic estimation, attainment and duality of the finite variance game, calibration by exhaustive semialgebraic enumeration in principle, and an upper detection rate for disjoint repeated motifs—not the claimed matched minimax frontier.
proof_attempt_summary: The run built and discharged a finite repeated-motif conditional-variance game, its attained dual, a nuisance-maximized calibration route, and a small-motif maximality audit showing no strict weight gain for maximum degree at most three or for K5. The matched all-test converse failed audit because the shifted-support Hellinger step omitted its symbolic cancellation certificate, while the advertised exact K3/C4 constants omitted machine-checkable quantifier-elimination certificates. A retry should preserve the finite-game substrate and focus only on those certificates before reclaiming the field-tier frontier.
tldr: Using the Bernoulli-half moment-reproduction identities and quadratic weight imported from GaoHarshawSavjeWang2026 Section 4 and Appendix B, this project studies a fixed network motif repeated under Bernoulli assignment. A \(2^h\)-row assignment table yields an exact robust semialgebraic program for the attained worst-schedule assignment-conditional variance and its least-favourable-prior dual. For a LinkedIn-style Bernoulli network experiment with a known repeated local motif, the contact-set certificate selects among feasible exposure-quadratic weights by the smallest worst bounded-schedule conditional-variance constant. The same table gives the explicit affinity factor \(L_H\), with exact constants for \(K_3\) and \(C_4\). The optimal quadratic statistic is calibrated at finite-sample level over every bounded no-spillover schedule, and its fourth-root RMS signal scale is unavoidable for every measurable test. A maximality audit proves that Gao's weight is minimax for every minimum-degree-two motif of maximum degree at most three and is the unique minimizer on the complete five-vertex motif, so no strict weight improvement is claimed from these smallest non-degree-two cases. Whether another motif with maximum degree at least four yields a strict weight gain, and whether the quadratic test attains the exact local power constant, remain open.
gap: GaoHarshawSavjeWang2026 arXiv version 2 Section 4 and Appendix B supply the Bernoulli quadratic-weight construction, while Proposition 4.1 gives a \(d_{\max}^5/n\) MSE envelope from Lemmas S3--S4; available randomization tests provide validity without a theoretical local-power frontier.
fill: The project computes the attained variance saddle from a \(2^h\)-row robust semialgebraic program, uses its contact set to select the feasible exposure-quadratic weight with the smallest worst bounded-schedule conditional-variance constant for a known repeated motif, derives exact worst-null calibration by finite assignment and sign-pattern enumeration, and proves a matching all-test fourth-root lower bound with an explicit motif-computable Hellinger constant and certified \(K_3\) and \(C_4\) comparisons.
